topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Well, I never thought to see such a thing. Old Tom, the quiet one who keeps to his own, has suddenly taken it into his head to run a fence 'round his land. They say he's digging the posts in as we speak. I've been tending the soil here, side by side with him, for more years than I can count, and never once did I see him so much as mark his boundaries. I remember when we all worked together, hands on the plow, keeping the bad luck at bay. Now there's talk of fences and what's mine and what's yours. I do wonder what the saints make of all this. It's just not the way things were done, not in these parts.
